title: drawmod
description:
[EN] Draw 3D glowing lines and geometric shapes, and save your art directly in the Minecraft world!
[RU] Рисуй светящиеся 3D-линии, геометрические фигуры и сохраняй свои арты прямо в мире Minecraft!
body:
Welcome to ZHX 3D Brush! 🎨
Created by ZHX Studio, this mod transforms your Minecraft world into a giant 3D canvas. Unleash your creativity and decorate your surroundings like never before!

✨ Key Features:

Draw in the Air: Create stunning artwork using glowing 3D lines right in the world.

Geometric Shapes: Easily draw various 3D shapes to enhance your builds.

Save Your Art: Your creations are saved directly in your Minecraft world so you can admire them later or show them to friends.

Perfect for builders, artists, and anyone who wants to add a creative and magical touch to their gameplay!
